DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease (likely Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome or similar left-sided obstructive lesion).

The combination of apnea, pallor, and the urgent need to rule out structural heart disease in an infant strongly suggests a critical cardiac defect causing heart failure and poor perfusion. While we await your CBC results to confirm anemia severity, the clinical picture of an infant with apnea and pallor until proven otherwise is cardiac in origin.
